zh: 金管局證監會合辦專題研討會
匯聚約200名行業從業員參與
探訪代幣化存款全天候運作
work.en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) and the Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) co-hosted a seminar on Project Ensemble and tokenised SFC-authorised investment products on 11 November. Around 200 industry practitioners attended the event, which showcased banks and industry pioneers exploring the 24/7 operation of tokenised deposits.
work.title: Project Ensemble Seeks Scale After Tokenised Deposits Go 24/7

zh: 港交所下月推數碼支付新方案
採用24/7央行數碼貨幣模式
便利衍生產品收市後預繳按金
work.en: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing (HKEX) will launch a new digital payment solution on 12 December based on its collaboration with the HKMA on wholesale CBDC. The service allows eligible futures clearing participants to submit margin payment applications from 5:00 PM to 1:30 AM. This enables market participants to manage capital-based position limits more flexibly outside standard banking hours.
work.title: 港交所下月推出新數碼支付方案 支付收市後交易時段預繳按金

zh: 金管局經貼现窗投放流動性
單日向港銀放水76.6億港元
創下接近7年以來的新高記錄
work.en: The HKMA injected HK$76.6 billion into the banking system through its discount window. This liquidity injection marks the highest single-day amount borrowed by local banks via the facility in nearly seven years.
work.title: 金管局經貼現窗向銀行放水76.6億 近7年最多

zh: 微軟系統早前發生全球故障
金管局確認港銀運作維持正常
呼籲市民留意詐騙並保持警惕
work.en: Following a global outage of Microsoft services, the HKMA announced that critical systems of retail banks in Hong Kong, including deposits and transfers, remained in normal operation. The regulator also urged the public to stay vigilant against potential scam attempts taking advantage of the glitch.
work.title: 【微軟全球大死機】金管局:港銀存款、轉帳等維持正常運作

zh: 金管局公布最新資產數據
外匯基金10月境外資產增加
單月增570億至3.63萬億
work.en: Data from the HKMA shows that the foreign assets of the Exchange Fund increased by HK$57 billion in October to reach HK$3,633 billion. During the period, the monetary base stood at HK$2,094.7 billion, while claims on the Hong Kong private sector totaled HK$427.8 billion.
work.title: 外匯基金上月境外資產增加570億港元

zh: 港元定期存款息率戰持續
長息突破新高高見3.6厘
短息推廣優惠更高達20厘
work.en: Banks in Hong Kong continue to adjust HKD time deposit rates, with long-term rates reaching a high of 3.6%. Short-term promotional rates are offering up to 20% across various deposit terms.
work.title: 定期存款

zh: AI企業暗面月之計劃赴港
傳最快明年初在港申請上市
集資規模最高可達50億美元
work.en: Artificial intelligence firm Moonshot AI, one of mainland China's 'AI Six Little Tigers', is reportedly planning an IPO in Hong Kong as early as early next year. The company aims to raise up to US$5 billion from the listing.

personal_hk.body:

juicy_sg.headline: Man Facing 41 Charges in Singapore Over Nvidia Microchip Smuggling Operation
juicy_sg.body: A man has been hit with 41 charges in Singapore local courts related to an illicit trade scheme involving high-end Nvidia AI microchips. The case comes amid heightened international scrutiny surrounding chip exports through Singapore.

juicy_sg.headline: Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Facing 3rd Affair Allegation as Wife Could Claim S$90B in Divorce
juicy_sg.body: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is facing fresh allegations of a third extramarital affair with a second Nvidia employee, sparking widespread divorce speculation. Reports suggest his wife Lori could be entitled to around US$70 billion (S$90 billion) should they separate.
juicy_sg.title: Jensen Huang’s 3rd affair allegations with 2nd Nvidia employee fuel divorce speculation; wife could get S$90B upon separation

juicy_sg.headline: Woman Sentenced to 13 Years' Jail for Role in Megan Khung Child Abuse Case
juicy_sg.body: A 36-year-old Singaporean woman was handed a 13-year prison sentence for her involvement in the severe abuse and disposal of four-year-old Megan Khung. The presiding judge advised the defendant to use her prison sentence to reflect on her horrific actions.
juicy_sg.title: ‘Use the time in prison to reflect on your actions’ — SG judge tells Singaporean woman, 36, who gets 13 years’ jail for conspiring in Megan Khung child abuse case

juicy_sg.headline: Suspected Maid Locks Herself in Clementi Flat with Knife During Police Standoff
juicy_sg.body: A 27-year-old domestic helper suspected of theft locked herself inside a Clementi residential flat with a knife, sparking a three-hour standoff with police officers. Emergency services later deployed forces and conveyed one person to the hospital following her arrest.
juicy_sg.title: Maid who was suspected of theft locks herself in Clementi flat with knife; SCDF conveyed one person to hospital

juicy_sg.headline: Fight Between 2 Thai Workers at Changi Airport Food Court Ends in 11-Week Jail Sentence
juicy_sg.body: An altercation broke out between two female Thai workers inside a food court at Changi Airport. One of the women was subsequently sentenced to 11 weeks in prison for her involvement in the brawl.
juicy_sg.title: 2 women, Thai workers, fight at Changi Airport food court, 1 jailed for 11 weeks

juicy_sg.headline: Fire at 80-Year-Old Chinatown TCM Shop Forces 40 Evacuations and Sends 2 to Hospital
juicy_sg.body: A fire broke out on 11 November at an 80-year-old traditional Chinese medicine and liquor establishment in Chinatown. Emergency services evacuated around 40 people from the building and sent two individuals to the hospital.
juicy_sg.title: Fire at 80-year-old Chinatown TCM and liquor shop sends 2 to hospital, forces 40 to evacuate
